title: Work & School
description: Talk about what you do all day.

questions.sentence: Aap kya kaam karte hain?
options: Main Delhi mein rehta hoon.
Main doctor hoon.
Main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main doctor hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am a doctor.

questions.sentence: Main ek bank mein kaam karta hoon.
options: I am going to the bank.
I work at a bank.
I have an account at this bank.
questions.correctAnswer: I work at a bank.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan kaam karte hain?
options: Main ek school mein kaam karta hoon.
Main subah jaldi kaam karta hoon.
Main teen saal se kaam kar raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main ek school mein kaam karta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a school.

questions.sentence: Meri behen ek teacher hai.
options: My sister is a student.
My sister has a good teacher.
My sister is a teacher.
questions.correctAnswer: My sister is a teacher.

questions.sentence: Kya aap student hain?
options: Haan, main college mein padhta hoon.
Haan, mera college bahut bada hai.
Nahi, mujhe padhna pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main college mein padhta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I study at a college.

questions.sentence: Main subah nau baje kaam par jaata hoon.
options: I go to work at nine in the morning.
I come home from work at nine.
I start my work at nine at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I go to work at nine in the morning.

questions.sentence: Tum kya karte ho?
options: Main abhi ghar par hoon.
Main aaj kaam nahi karta.
Main engineer hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main engineer hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am an engineer.

questions.sentence: Mujhe apna kaam bahut pasand hai.
options: I like my job a lot.
My work is very hard.
I am very good at my job.
questions.correctAnswer: I like my job a lot.

questions.sentence: Aapka office kahan hai?
options: Mera office bahut bada hai.
Mera office Jaipur mein hai.
Main roz office jaata hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera office Jaipur mein hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My office is in Jaipur.

questions.sentence: Aaj class mein kitne bachche hain?
options: Class mein bees bachche hain.
Class nau baje shuru hoti hai.
Bachche abhi ghar ja rahe hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Class mein bees bachche hain.
questions.translatedSentence: There are twenty children in the class.

questions.sentence: Teacher blackboard par likh rahi hain.
options: The teacher is reading from a book.
The teacher is writing on the blackboard.
The teacher is cleaning the blackboard.
questions.correctAnswer: The teacher is writing on the blackboard.

questions.sentence: Kya tumhare paas Hindi ki kitab hai?
options: Haan, meri kitab bag mein hai.
Haan, main roz Hindi padhta hoon.
Nahi, meri class abhi shuru nahi hui.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, meri kitab bag mein hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, my book is in my bag.

questions.sentence: Mujhe ek sawaal poochna hai.
options: I want to ask a question.
I want to answer this question.
I have one question left.
questions.correctAnswer: I want to ask a question.

questions.sentence: Class kitne baje shuru hoti hai?
options: Class bade kamre mein hoti hai.
Class do ghante chalti hai.
Class dus baje shuru hoti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Class dus baje shuru hoti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The class starts at ten o'clock.

questions.sentence: Bachche apni copy mein likh rahe hain.
options: The children are looking for their notebooks.
The children are reading from their notebooks.
The children are writing in their notebooks.
questions.correctAnswer: The children are writing in their notebooks.

questions.sentence: Kya aapko yeh sawaal samajh aaya?
options: Nahi, mujhe thoda samajh nahi aaya.
Haan, main class mein baitha hoon.
Nahi, mera pen kaam nahi kar raha.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, mujhe thoda samajh nahi aaya.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I did not quite understand it.

questions.sentence: Teacher ne hamein ghar ka kaam diya hai.
options: The teacher has given us homework.
The teacher has checked our homework.
The teacher gives homework every day.
questions.correctAnswer: The teacher has given us homework.

questions.sentence: Tumhari pasandida class kaun si hai?
options: Mera school ghar ke paas hai.
Mujhe Hindi ki class pasand hai.
Meri class subah hoti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe Hindi ki class pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I like the Hindi class.

questions.sentence: Aapki meeting kitne baje hai?
options: Meri meeting gyarah baje hai.
Meeting bade kamre mein hai.
Main meeting mein baithna chahta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Meri meeting gyarah baje hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My meeting is at eleven o'clock.

questions.sentence: Main aapko abhi email bhej deta hoon.
options: I got your email just now.
I will call you right away.
I will send you the email right away.
questions.correctAnswer: I will send you the email right away.

questions.sentence: Kya aapne meri email padh li?
options: Haan, maine subah hi padh li thi.
Haan, mera computer band hai.
Nahi, mera phone desk par rakha hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, maine subah hi padh li thi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I read it first thing in the morning.

questions.sentence: Mera computer aaj kaam nahi kar raha hai.
options: My computer is not working today.
My computer is very old now.
I am not working on my computer today.
questions.correctAnswer: My computer is not working today.

questions.sentence: Kya boss abhi office mein hain?
options: Haan, unka desk khali hai.
Nahi, woh meeting mein gaye hain.
Nahi, mujhe unka number pata hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, woh meeting mein gaye hain.
questions.translatedSentence: No, he has gone into a meeting.

questions.sentence: Meri desk khidki ke paas hai.
options: My desk is near the door.
My desk is next to the window.
There is a window above my desk.
questions.correctAnswer: My desk is next to the window.

questions.sentence: Yeh file kiski hai?
options: Yeh file bahut purani hai.
File meri desk par rakh dijiye.
Yeh file mere boss ki hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Yeh file mere boss ki hai.
questions.translatedSentence: This file belongs to my boss.

questions.sentence: Meeting ke baad main aapse baat karunga.
options: I talked to you before the meeting.
I will talk to you after the meeting.
Let us talk during the meeting.
questions.correctAnswer: I will talk to you after the meeting.

questions.sentence: Chai peene chalein?
options: Haan, chaliye, mujhe bhi chai chahiye.
Haan, meri meeting abhi shuru hui hai.
Nahi, mera office yahan se door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, chaliye, mujhe bhi chai chahiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, let us go, I could use a tea too.

questions.sentence: Tumne apna ghar ka kaam kar liya?
options: Nahi, abhi tak nahi kiya, thoda baaki hai.
Haan, mujhe abhi ghar jaana hai.
Nahi, mera bag ghar par reh gaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, abhi tak nahi kiya, thoda baaki hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I have not done it yet, a little is left.

questions.sentence: Kal mera Hindi ka exam hai isliye main aaj raat padhunga.
options: I studied last night because my Hindi exam was today.
My Hindi exam is tonight, so I studied yesterday.
My Hindi exam is tomorrow, so I will study tonight.
questions.correctAnswer: My Hindi exam is tomorrow, so I will study tonight.

questions.sentence: Exam kaisa gaya?
options: Exam agle hafte shuru hoga.
Achha gaya, lekin ek sawaal mushkil tha.
Main exam ke liye roz padh raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Achha gaya, lekin ek sawaal mushkil tha.
questions.translatedSentence: It went well, but one question was hard.

questions.sentence: Mujhe har roz do ghante padhna padta hai.
options: I have to study for two hours every day.
I like to study for two hours every day.
I studied for two hours yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: I have to study for two hours every day.

questions.sentence: Tum itni der se kya padh rahe ho?
options: Main kal raat der se soya tha.
Mujhe science bilkul pasand nahi hai.
Main science padh raha hoon, kal test hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main science padh raha hoon, kal test hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am studying science, there is a test tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Agar main roz padhunga to exam aasan lagega.
options: Since I studied every day, the exam felt easy.
If I study every day, the exam will feel easy.
I study every day, but the exam is not easy.
questions.correctAnswer: If I study every day, the exam will feel easy.

questions.sentence: Kya main tumhari copy dekh sakta hoon?
options: Haan, lekin kal mujhe wapas kar dena.
Haan, meri copy ghar par rakhi hai.
Nahi, mujhe nayi copy chahiye thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, lekin kal mujhe wapas kar dena.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but give it back to me tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Maine kitab padh li hai lekin mujhe sab yaad nahi hai.
options: I have read the book, but I do not remember all of it.
I am reading the book because I do not remember it.
I will read the book again so that I remember it.
questions.correctAnswer: I have read the book, but I do not remember all of it.

questions.sentence: Exam ka result kab aayega?
options: Result bahut achha aaya tha.
Result agle mahine aayega.
Exam agle mahine hoga.
questions.correctAnswer: Result agle mahine aayega.
questions.translatedSentence: The result will come next month.

questions.sentence: Aap aaj itni der se kyun aaye?
options: Maaf kijiye, metro mein bahut bheed thi.
Haan, main roz jaldi aa jaata hoon.
Mujhe kal subah chutti chahiye thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Maaf kijiye, metro mein bahut bheed thi.
questions.translatedSentence: Sorry, the metro was very crowded.

questions.sentence: Mujhe kal chutti chahiye kyunki mere bhai ki shaadi hai.
options: I took leave yesterday for my brother's wedding.
I need leave tomorrow because my brother is getting married.
My brother needs leave tomorrow for a wedding.
questions.correctAnswer: I need leave tomorrow because my brother is getting married.

questions.sentence: Aap roz office kaise aate hain?
options: Main nau baje office pahunch jaata hoon.
Mera office metro station ke paas hai.
Main metro se aata hoon, woh sasti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main metro se aata hoon, woh sasti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I come by metro, it is cheap.

questions.sentence: Aaj traffic itna tha ki main aadhe ghante late ho gaya.
options: There was so much traffic today that I was half an hour late.
There was traffic today, but I reached half an hour early.
I left half an hour late today, so I was stuck in traffic.
questions.correctAnswer: There was so much traffic today that I was half an hour late.

questions.sentence: Aapka office kitne baje band hota hai?
options: Office subah jaldi khulta hai.
Office shaam ko chhah baje band hota hai.
Main shaam ko ghar chala jaata hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Office shaam ko chhah baje band hota hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The office closes at six in the evening.

questions.sentence: Agar auto rickshaw nahi mila to main paidal chala jaunga.
options: I did not get an auto rickshaw, so I walked.
If I do not get an auto rickshaw, I will walk.
I would rather take an auto rickshaw than walk.
questions.correctAnswer: If I do not get an auto rickshaw, I will walk.

questions.sentence: Kya main aaj thoda jaldi ja sakta hoon?
options: Haan, lekin apna kaam khatam kar dijiye.
Haan, main kal chutti par tha.
Nahi, aaj office jaldi khula tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, lekin apna kaam khatam kar dijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but please finish your work first.

questions.sentence: Main pichhle hafte do din chutti par tha.
options: I will be on leave for two days next week.
I have taken two days of leave this week.
I was on leave for two days last week.
questions.correctAnswer: I was on leave for two days last week.

questions.sentence: Aap chutti mein kya karenge?
options: Mujhe chutti nahi mil rahi hai.
Main apne ghar Lucknow jaunga.
Main roz auto rickshaw se aata hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main apne ghar Lucknow jaunga.
questions.translatedSentence: I will go home to Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Aap agle saal kya karna chahte hain?
options: Main naya kaam dhoondhna chahta hoon, kyunki yeh kaam ab aasan lagta hai.
Main pichhle saal Jaipur mein kaam karta tha.
Mujhe pichhle saal lambi chutti mili thi.
questions.correctAnswer: Main naya kaam dhoondhna chahta hoon, kyunki yeh kaam ab aasan lagta hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to look for a new job, because this one feels easy now.

questions.sentence: Agar mera kaam achha raha to mujhe agle saal promotion mil sakta hai.
options: My work was good, so I got a promotion last year.
If my work is good, I may get a promotion next year.
I will get a promotion next year, but my work is not good.
questions.correctAnswer: If my work is good, I may get a promotion next year.

questions.sentence: Aapko is kaam mein sabse mushkil kya lagta hai?
options: Yeh kaam maine pichhle saal shuru kiya tha.
Mujhe subah jaldi uthna mushkil lagta hai, baaki sab theek hai.
Mujhe yeh kaam ab bilkul nahi karna hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe subah jaldi uthna mushkil lagta hai, baaki sab theek hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I find getting up early the hard part, the rest is fine.

questions.sentence: Main Hindi seekh raha hoon taaki main apne clients se baat kar sakoon.
options: I learned Hindi because my clients speak it.
I want to learn Hindi, but my clients do not speak it.
I am learning Hindi so that I can talk to my clients.
questions.correctAnswer: I am learning Hindi so that I can talk to my clients.

questions.sentence: Kya aap kisi naye shehar mein kaam karna chahenge?
options: Haan, agar tankhwah achhi ho to main Delhi ja sakta hoon.
Haan, yeh shehar mujhe bahut pasand hai isliye main yahin rahunga.
Nahi, maine pichhle saal hi naya kaam shuru kiya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, agar tankhwah achhi ho to main Delhi ja sakta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, if the pay is good I could move to Delhi.

questions.sentence: Mujhe apna kaam pasand hai lekin main aur seekhna chahta hoon.
options: I like my job, but I want to learn more.
I do not like my job, so I want to learn something else.
I liked my job while I was still learning.
questions.correctAnswer: I like my job, but I want to learn more.

questions.sentence: Kya aapne boss se promotion ke baare mein baat ki?
options: Haan, unhone kaha ki woh agle mahine sochenge.
Nahi, mera boss kal chutti par tha isliye office band tha.
Haan, main agle saal se naya kaam shuru karunga.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, unhone kaha ki woh agle mahine sochenge.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, he said he would think about it next month.

questions.sentence: Jab mujhe promotion milega tab main apne parivaar ko khaana khilane le jaunga.
options: After my promotion, my family took me out for a meal.
When I get my promotion, I will take my family out for a meal.
If I get a promotion, my family will cook a big meal.
questions.correctAnswer: When I get my promotion, I will take my family out for a meal.

questions.sentence: Aap paanch saal baad khud ko kahan dekhte hain?
options: Paanch saal pehle main Lucknow mein padhta tha.
Mujhe paanch din ki chutti chahiye hogi.
Main apni company shuru karna chahta hoon, isliye abhi bahut mehnat kar raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main apni company shuru karna chahta hoon, isliye abhi bahut mehnat kar raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to start my own company, so I am working very hard right now.
